# resides in

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:residesIn`](gmeow-residesIn.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/residesIn>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/email`](../../slices/email.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Relates a message to a mailbox/label it currently resides in. Time-varying residence is reified as [`gmeow:MailboxResidence`](../classes/gmeow-MailboxResidence.md); on this convenience property the period may be carried with gmeow:validFrom/validUntil.

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Message`](../classes/gmeow-Message.md) -> [`gmeow:Mailbox`](../classes/gmeow-Mailbox.md)
